# A. Federal Mandates {.unnumbered}

Every UIAO control, every policy, every piece of evidence ultimately
traces to a federal mandate. This sub-category documents the mandates
themselves, their scope, their UIAO mapping, and the cadence at which
UIAO re-validates against each.

## Leaves

Grouped by authority type. Leaf identifiers **A.1–A.9** are stable and
referenced from sibling pages — new mandates are appended (A.10+) rather
than renumbered.

### Authorization programs (FedRAMP)

- **A.1** FedRAMP Moderate
- **A.2** FedRAMP High
- **A.10** FedRAMP 20x — the modernized program (Key Security Indicators,
  Minimum Assessment Scope, RFC-0026 CA-7 pathway, Rev5 machine-readable
  packages). Current substrate posture is tracked in the
  [20x Moderate pilot finding](../../../findings/fedramp-20x-moderate-pilot.qmd).
  *Rev5 → 20x migration guidance is authored under the dedicated migration
  program; this leaf is the mandate-catalog entry, not the migration runbook.*

### CISA operational directives

- **A.3** CISA SCuBA / [BOD 25-01](https://cyber.dhs.gov/bod/25-01/) — [adapter](../../adapter-specs/scuba/scuba.html)
- **A.11** CISA [BOD 26-04](../../../findings/fedramp-bod-26-04-vdr-ver-mandate.qmd) — risk-based vulnerability remediation SLAs (VDR/VER mandate)

### Executive & OMB policy

- **A.4** Executive Orders (14028, 14110, 13800, successors)
- **A.12** OMB Memoranda — M-22-09 (Federal Zero Trust Strategy),
  M-24-10 (Advancing Governance, Innovation, and Risk Management for
  Agency Use of AI)

### Statute

- **A.5** FISMA

### NIST standards

- **A.6** NIST 800-53 Rev 5
- **A.7** NIST 800-171 (CUI)
- **A.13** NIST SP 800-137 — Information Security Continuous Monitoring
  (ISCM); the basis of the UIAO continuous-monitoring strategy
- **A.14** NIST SP 800-161 — Cyber Supply Chain Risk Management (C-SCRM)
- **A.9** [NIST + FICAM Cross-Walk — UIAO substrate alignment with NIST IR 8011, NIST SP 800-157, NIST SP 800-63 series, and FICAM Architecture v3](nist-icam-crosswalk.qmd)

### DoD

- **A.8** DoD IL4 / IL5 — *future-state*
